coverage.description: At depth<3 and with a named owner, inspect the full event list for direct facts and applicable owner relations; reject moved-after-relation histories. Otherwise initialize an optional unknown from initial_ev and any told Is state, then fold events matching owner/thing/time, excluding Is/Rel and outside events for owner=None. Set and Add both add; Sub subtracts.
